summary: Frontend-only verification for the re-added AdMob interstitial + 'No ads' PRO messaging. Everything requested is green in the Expo web preview: (1) app.json is valid JSON and the react-native-google-mobile-ads plugin is in the correct array form with androidAppId (Google test id ca-app-pub-3940256099942544~3347511713), iosAppId (user-supplied ca-app-pub-5769184493980714~3209653620) and userTrackingUsageDescription — verified via python json.load + view. Metro builds without errors and all 5 tabs (Tree / Goals / Focus / Friends / Profile) render in the mobile web preview with no red screen. (2) Timer flow: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx correctly imports useCompletionInterstitial from '@/src/lib/ads' (Metro auto-resolves ads.web.ts on web via .web.ts extension → the platform-shim no-op) and calls preload() when a session starts (line 207: `if (!isSubscribed) preload();`) plus showIfReady() after recap dismiss ONLY when !isSubscribed with 500ms iOS defer (line 445). Live-tested a 1-minute custom session end-to-end: preset-custom → custom-minutes-input='1' → custom-start-button → focus-locked-screen appears → ~65s wait → session-recap-screen renders with recap-xp='+2', recap-minutes='1', recap-streak='🔥 1', recap-today='1' → recap-close-button dismisses cleanly and the app REMAINS FULLY INTERACTIVE with no black screen and no crash (verified by re-tapping preset-custom → custom-minutes-input re-appears). Web ads are correctly a no-op — no network calls to AdMob and showIfReady() returns false without side-effects. (3) PRO copy: pro-features-card on Profile shows exactly 5 benefits in the required order — '🚫 No ads' → '❄️ Monthly streak freeze' (with freeze-count testID showing '0') → '💚 Free tree revives' → '🏅 Golden PRO badge' → '✨ Early access to new features'; /paywall PERKS list starts with 'No ads after your focus sessions' followed by 'A free streak freeze every month', 'Revive your tree any time it dies', 'Golden PRO badge on the leaderboard', 'Support the app and keep it growing'; settings-sheet Sproutly PRO row subtitle for non-PRO reads exactly 'No ads, monthly freezes, revives + golden badge'. (4) Regression: locked-in mode drives focus-locked-screen → give-up-button → give-up-confirm-button → focus-lock-death-modal ('Your tree died' with 'Go to my tree' + 'Dismiss') just as before. Settings cog sheet opens with all four rows (notifications-switch, focus-lock-switch, strict-lock-switch, delete-account-row) present and interactive. Cleanup done: plant_f950c13f4790 restored to is_dead=false with died_at unset (name 'Oakley II', xp 266); no leftover focus_sessions spam (10 rows total for ui-test-user, matches historical count).
critical_code_review_comments: app.json:57-64 — react-native-google-mobile-ads plugin is in the correct expanded array form. androidAppId uses the Google test AdMob id (ca-app-pub-3940256099942544~3347511713) which is expected because Android will use TestIds at runtime; iOS uses the user-supplied real app id ca-app-pub-5769184493980714~3209653620. userTrackingUsageDescription is set. Nothing to change.

src/lib/ads.native.ts:14 — interstitialUnitId falls back to TestIds.INTERSTITIAL when __DEV__ OR when productionUnitId is missing. On iOS EXPO_PUBLIC_ADMOB_IOS_INTERSTITIAL is set in .env (ca-app-pub-5769184493980714/2036172756), so a production/TestFlight iOS build will serve the real ad unit while dev builds keep the test unit. Android has NO EXPO_PUBLIC_ADMOB_ANDROID_INTERSTITIAL in frontend/.env, so Android will always use TestIds.INTERSTITIAL — matches the review requirement ('Android uses Google test IDs'). Good.

src/lib/ads.native.ts:6,17-18 — Expo Go is correctly detected via ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient and unitId is nulled out; useInterstitialAd(null) is a safe no-op. This prevents native module crashes in Expo Go for anyone loading the QR-code preview.

src/lib/ads.web.ts — deliberate no-op hook (isLoaded:false, preload no-op, showIfReady→false). Metro's .web.ts platform-extension resolution swaps this in for web/preview so no import of react-native-google-mobile-ads is attempted in the bundle — the module is not available on web. Correct pattern.

app/(tabs)/timer.tsx:44 — useCompletionInterstitial(!isSubscribed) correctly disables the ad hook for PRO users. When RevenueCat identity resolves to isSubscribed=true this becomes useCompletionInterstitial(false) → unitId=null → preload/showIfReady no-op. Gating logic verified by inspection.
app/(tabs)/timer.tsx:207 — preload() is only called on non-PRO (`if (!isSubscribed) preload();`) at session START. Good — matches AdMob best practice of preloading well before show.

app/(tabs)/timer.tsx:445 — showIfReady() only fires on recap dismiss and only when !isSubscribed, with a 500ms iOS defer to let the recap modal finish dismissing before the full-screen ad appears (this is the exact fix that was needed to avoid the earlier black-screen issue). On Android the defer is 150ms. Correct.

profile.tsx:260-298 — pro-features-card benefit ordering is fixed in JSX in the exact required order: No ads → Monthly streak freeze → Free tree revives → Golden PRO badge → Early access. Verified by DOM inspection in the preview.
paywall.tsx:12-18 — PERKS array starts with 'No ads after your focus sessions'. Verified by DOM inspection in the preview.
profile.tsx:428-431 — settings-sheet PRO row subtitle for non-PRO exactly matches 'No ads, monthly freezes, revives + golden badge'. Verified by DOM inspection.

Preview limitation (not a bug): RevenueCat Browser Mode keeps the caller anonymous (identity 429 in web) so useSubscription().isSubscribed is permanently false in the preview — the ad path (non-PRO) is what gets exercised end-to-end. The PRO/no-ads branch (useCompletionInterstitial(false) → showIfReady no-op) is only verifiable via code inspection here, but the source clearly gates on !isSubscribed at every ad callsite.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for everything reachable in the web preview (timer flow with ad no-op, PRO copy on Profile/Paywall/Settings, locked-in give-up death flow)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused seeded ui-test-user + uitest_token_123 and plant_f950c13f4790.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ad integration is gated at three layers: (a) platform (ads.web.ts no-op vs ads.native.ts), (b) Expo Go detection (ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient → null unitId), (c) PRO subscription (!isSubscribed passed to useCompletionInterstitial). Web preview only exercises layer (a). To test real AdMob interstitial you need an EAS dev-build or production iOS/Android build — Expo Go will NOT show the ad (unitId is nulled out). AndroidId in app.json is intentionally the Google test app id since production Android uses TestIds.INTERSTITIAL at runtime (no EXPO_PUBLIC_ADMOB_ANDROID_INTERSTITIAL in .env). If the user later provides a real Android app id / ad unit id, both androidAppId in app.json and EXPO_PUBLIC_ADMOB_ANDROID_INTERSTITIAL in frontend/.env should be filled in. Cleanup at end of run: plant_f950c13f4790 is_dead=false with died_at unset, name 'Oakley II', xp 266; ui-test-user user_settings doc is absent (defaults apply); focus_sessions collection has 10 total rows for ui-test-user (no unbounded spam).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bug. The one thing the web preview cannot exercise (real AdMob interstitial appearing over the recap and PRO-gated no-op path when isSubscribed=true) is a testing-environment limitation of Expo web + RevenueCat Browser Mode, not a defect. Gating logic verified by code inspection at timer.tsx:44, 207, 445.
